description: Network ▸ Straighten Network and Straighten and Fit to Window (both undoable, both rewrite positions) on a two-class finite example, and the view commands: zoom in / out about the viewport centre, Set Zoom, zoom about a point, Zoom to Fit, Zoom to Selection, Actual Size, scroll pans, a Pan-tool drag, sticky pan from a double-click and the click that ends it; none of the view commands touch the undo stack.
